sense: of the sex that does not bear young

terms.gloss: male; as a noun, a male
terms.grammar: adjective and masculine noun, third declension
evidence: Varr. LL 9.56: appellātur mās columbus, fēmina columba

terms.comment: Not in Cicero or Caesar (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: nunc contrā, propter domesticōs ūsūs quod internōvimus, appellātur mās columbus, fēmina columba
phrases.english: now, on the other hand, since keeping them at home has taught us to tell them apart, the male is called columbus and the female columba

phrases.latin: gallīnam in marem, gallum in fēminam sēsē vertisse
phrases.english: that a hen had turned into a cock, and a cock into a hen

phrases.latin: duo et duo ingressa sunt ad Noë in arcam, masculus et fēmina
phrases.english: two by two they went in to Noah into the ark, male and female

sources: Lewis & Short: mas · Lewis & Short: masculus · Lewis & Short: virilis
